audit_explanations.artifact_0.793_root_cause: In scripts/evaluate_milestone_08e_independent_confirmation.py, lines 277-282 evaluated compute_wilson_ci(ood_false_10k, max(ood_accepted, 1)). When ood_accepted == 0, the denominator was forced to 1, computing the Wilson score upper bound for 0 failures out of N=1 trial: (0 + z^2/2)/(1 + z^2) + z*sqrt(z^2/4)/(1 + z^2) = 0.79345. This was incorrectly reported as the confidence interval for an empty accepted cohort.
audit_explanations.unconditional_vs_conditional_conflation: For R2 (U1 Single-Pass), 11 out of 100 queries were accepted, and all 11 had MaxAE > 10 K. The unconditional rate is 11/100 = 11.0% with 95% CI [0.0625, 0.1863]. The conditional failure rate is 11/11 = 100.0% with 95% CI [0.7412, 1.0000]. The 08E table listed '11 / 100' beside '[0.741, 1.000]', conflating the unconditional sample count with the conditional confidence interval.
audit_explanations.rule_of_three_unconditional_risk: For policies with 0 observed failures out of 100 queries (R0, R1, R3), the unconditional failure probability upper bound is 3.62% (via Wilson score) and 3.0% (via Rule of Three: 3/N). Zero observed failures does not equal zero underlying risk.

threshold_audit.units: Dimensionless percentage of dominant heat term
threshold_audit.rationale: A threshold of 115.16% allows energy imbalance to exceed 100% of generated heat. It was calibrated as the 90th percentile of FNO prediction errors on calibration data, meaning it rejects the worst 10% of surrogate predictions. It cannot be defended as a physical conservation guarantee. A true physical conservation criterion must bound relative flux imbalance to <= 1.0% to 5.0% of total domain throughput.

regime_1_pure_conduction_high_throughput.description: Zero internal source (q=0), 10 kW flowing in west, 10 kW flowing out east
regime_1_pure_conduction_high_throughput.verdict: False alarm: formula blows up to 100% despite high physical conservation accuracy (2% error).

regime_2_high_internal_source.description: Intense source (10 kW generated), surrogate predicts 21.5 kW boundary outflow
regime_2_high_internal_source.verdict: Allows complete energy non-conservation: 115.16% error means more spurious energy is created than generated.

model_family.R3: Multi-pass spatial Monte Carlo Dropout (MCDropoutFNO2D, T=3)

economics_of_recalibration.problem: If R3's uncertainty threshold tau_unc is tightened from 7.44 K down to 3.50 K to guarantee that accepted IID queries satisfy MaxAE <= 10.0 K, R3's IID acceptance rate plummets to < 5%.
economics_of_recalibration.resulting_speedup: 566 ms / 715 ms = 0.79x (A 21% net computational SLOWDOWN vs. Direct FVM!)
economics_of_recalibration.conclusion: R3 cannot deliver simultaneous safety (MaxAE <= 10 K) and acceleration (> 1.0x). When safe, it is slower than FVM. When faster than FVM, 75.8% of accepted queries are unsafe.

phase6_production_promotion_decision.executive_rationale: 1. Safety Violation on IID Queries: While R3 successfully rejects 100% of OOD queries, 75.8% of the in-distribution queries it accepts violate the engineering tolerance of MaxAE <= 10.0 K (mean accepted MaxAE = 15.75 K, peaking at 28.5 K). 2. Economic Inviability: Tightening thresholds to eliminate these IID failures suppresses R3 acceptance to < 5%, causing total latency to increase to ~715 ms due to fallback overhead (a 21% net slowdown vs. FVM). 3. Marginal Speedup: Even under unsafe acceptance, R3's mixed speedup is only 1.03x (vs. 1.05x for R1). A 1.03x speedup with high local error risk does not justify replacing the verified production baseline. R3 must remain a research candidate.
